name: TMT (India) Ltd.
summary: TMT (India) Ltd. offers services in the provision of designs and technical drawings. The company is also active in the distribution and sale of natural botanical extracts and essential oils. Its diverse product line includes compounds like curcumin, boswellic acid, both double and single garcinia salts, aswagandha, bacopa, dried tribulus terrestris, green tea extract, coleus, ginger oleoresin, pepper extract, and coffee extract. Established on March 8, 1976, the firm's main office is located in Hyderabad, India.
